blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY, South Cotabato — Police placed Isulan National High School in Sultan Kudarat province under lockdown Wednesday morning after teachers and students reported hearing what appeared to be a gunshot inside the campus. The Isulan Municipal Police Station imposed the lockdown as authorities carried out safety procedures and checked the school in Barangay Kalawag
